description: mlpeek: Reduce background noise in speech audio. Returns mono 12 kHz WAV/MP3/Ogg speech audio with steady noise reduced by FFmpeg afftdn (no model weights), duration and filter. Public URL or base64, up to 25 MB and 10 minutes; base64 or output=url. Not voice isolation; music and changing noise may remain, and speech may sound altered. Exact/credits are flat; upto bills started minutes after a 0.25 s tolerance, minimum one. A missing processor is a 503 processor_unavailable; failed jobs are not charged. Typically 1-20 s. Price: USD 0.02. No free tier. Audio is not logged; it is written to private scratch files deleted after the call; only `output` "url" keeps the result (24 h). Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/embeddings-rerank-ner-mcp-server.html
